measurement_notes: Two screenshot checks are manually reviewed. Ordinary-node radius uses a same-node canvas probe because the automatic most-frequent-radius heuristic can select focus rings. The raw automated result is retained separately; the frozen acceptance criterion is unchanged.
interpretation: The owner's roughly 60% starting assessment is qualitative. The original published interface scored 35/100 against this frozen 20-check engineering rubric; the prior unpublished candidate already scored 100/100. The final score is functional acceptance, not a measured percentage of user satisfaction or proof that this revamp caused every baseline-to-release gain.

improvements.title: Keep connected graph nodes in view
improvements.before: Focused entry sample: desktop 27/31 nodes visible; mobile 29/31.
improvements.after: 31/31 visible at both sizes; six dense stress views also fit all contextual nodes.
improvements.solution: Fit connection bounds automatically; separate Fit all and Fit connections controls.

improvements.title: Keep labels off the nodes they describe
improvements.before: Contextual node-label occlusions: 3 desktop, 7 mobile in matched samples.
improvements.after: Zero in those samples and six dense stress views.
improvements.solution: Labels avoid contextual nodes, move with leader lines, and retain accessible list/search alternatives.

improvements.title: Reach candidate choices with less scrolling
improvements.before: Longest-operation comparison: candidate controls at 1480px desktop and 3469px mobile.
improvements.after: 934px desktop and 1718px mobile (36.9% and 50.5% less vertical travel).
improvements.solution: Progressive disclosure keeps full operations and examples available; evidence and actions appear sooner.

improvements.title: Read metadata and operate controls
improvements.before: Light hints/counts contrast 2.18:1; sampled nav/pin targets as small as 39.4px.
improvements.after: Light secondary text 7.81:1; sampled nav/pin targets at least 44px.
improvements.solution: Targeted contrast corrections and responsive navigation spacing; light/dark screenshots inspected.

improvements.title: Retrieve every candidate without duplicating all illustrations
improvements.before: Candidate display stopped at 40; 243-candidate full download 1,170,637 bytes.
improvements.after: All 243 accessible through pagination; compact download 622,857 bytes (46.8% smaller).
improvements.solution: Explicit compact/full modes retain all candidate operations, selection guidance and evidence; omitted example counts and links are visible.

improvements.title: Recover from bad links and incomplete data
improvements.before: Unknown routes fell back to the index; malformed data could contaminate retry state.
improvements.after: Explicit missing-page recovery and schema validation; six malformed-data/retry cases restore clean 979-entry/192-group indexes.
improvements.solution: Validate before rebuilding indexes; expose Retry, preserve workspace state, and handle offline status.

runtime: Headless Chromium on Linux x64; browser-emulated desktop/mobile layouts. Performance rubric uses fresh browser contexts over unthrottled loopback, not real mobile-network measurements.
limits: No physical-device or assistive-technology user study has been performed; owner aesthetic judgment remains separate.
The functional checklist was already satisfied by the previous unpublished candidate; new revamp gains are listed separately.
The raw data payload is about 8.8 MB (about 2.65 MB gzip). A 4× CPU, 1.6 Mbps, 150ms-latency uncompressed HTTP simulation took about 43.5 seconds to load; it remains bandwidth-sensitive.
Corpus counts are observations, not outcome or causal evidence. Merge/split proposals are outside this UX release.
